summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repo (not run, per instructions). Changes: rich/progress.py adds Task.finished_time field, finished property now reads finished_time, latch capture in update() and advance(), clearing in Task._reset() and Progress.reset(), and the TimeElapsedColumn class between TimeRemainingColumn and FileSizeColumn. rich/default_styles.py adds progress.elapsed (yellow). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased/Added entry. tests/test_progress.py adds test_time_elapsed_column and adds TimeElapsedColumn to test_columns with a hand-derived expected string. Unverified: the test_columns expected output (bar widths of 25 and 15 and clock call counts were inferred by tracing, not measured), and stop/exit frames were assumed not to call the clock for finished tasks. No commits made.
